topic: Project Iceworm: The Secret US Nuclear City Under Greenland Ice
query: Project Iceworm: The Secret US Nuclear City Under Greenland Ice
summary: Project Iceworm was a top secret United States Army program of the Cold War, which aimed to build a network of mobile nuclear missile launch sites under the Greenland ice sheet. The goal was to install a vast network of nuclear missile launch sites that could survive a first strike, according to the Danish Institute for International Studies, which obtained declassified documents in 1996. The missiles, which could strike targets within the Soviet Union, were never fielded and necessary consent from the Danish government to do so was never obtained.
